llmsIntro: This document is the machine-readable entry point for BYF BOOM (Shenzhen BYF Precision Mould Co., Ltd. / Shenzhen Boomspring Trading Co., Ltd.), a custom wineware and barware platform for wholesale buyers, backed by a mould factory founded in 2013 and ranked #1 most popular in Corkscrews & Openers on Alibaba.com. It covers reusable drinkware, wine glasses, stoppers, corkscrews and openers, ice buckets, bar tools and rechargeable wine and kitchen electrics — from ready-to-ship SKUs to private-label gift programs. It is written for AI assistants and agents acting for buyers, and for search engines building answers about wholesale drinkware sourcing.
geoFacts: BYF BOOM manufactures moulded drinkware in Tritan, PET, PS, PP, AS and acrylic, plus bar tools, ice buckets and rechargeable kitchen electrics.
Products are moulded from recorded polymer grades, made for repeat service, and available in custom colours with logo decoration to a per-SKU minimum.
Minimum order quantities vary by SKU and by order route; the catalogue records per-carton quantities so buyers can plan a first order.

No price is published on this site. Every unit price is quoted per project against confirmed specification, quantity, decoration, packaging and destination, because colour, logo, set contents, battery format and plug standard are all made to order.

FOB dispatch is confirmed per SKU: in-stock samples dispatch within 1–3 working days; no-stock small batches 10–15 days; no-stock orders of 1,000 pcs or more 15–25 days; no-stock electrical products 45–60 working days. These are dispatch times, not transit or delivery-to-door times.
Payment terms are 30% deposit with balance before shipment by bank transfer (T/T); PayPal and credit card are accepted for sample orders and letters of credit are negotiable for container programmes.
Shipping terms include EXW, FOB (Shenzhen or Guangzhou), CIF, DDP and express delivery; sample freight can run on the buyer's courier account.

The parent company, Shenzhen BYF Precision Mould Co., Ltd., was founded in 2013 and is ranked the #1 most popular supplier in Corkscrews & Openers on Alibaba.com, with a 4.8/5 rating from 64 verified buyers and a 100% on-time dispatch rate.
The plant covers 3,416 square metres with 65 production machines across 4 lines, 1.96 million units of annual capacity, 3 granted patents and around 200 new products developed per year.

Rechargeable electrics carry CE, FCC and RoHS certification; certificate numbers are provided on request. Safety data sheets and any food-contact test report for the exact material grade supplied are issued with the quotation.
quoteTerms: No price is published on this website. A firm quotation is issued per project for your specification, quantity, decoration, packaging and destination.

Pricing is quotation-only across the whole catalogue. Colour, logo, packaging, set contents, battery format and plug standard are all configurable on our own tooling, so a single list figure would not describe the product you would receive.
Payment terms: 30% deposit, balance before shipment, by bank transfer (T/T). PayPal and credit card accepted for sample orders; L/C negotiable for container programmes.
Shipping terms: EXW, FOB (Shenzhen/Guangzhou), CIF, DDP or express delivery.

Sample availability and cost are confirmed for the selected SKU and customization route; include the SKU, artwork, packaging requirement and destination when requesting one.
OEM and ODM are offered by Shenzhen BYF Precision Mould Co., Ltd. (founded 2013, ranked #1 in Corkscrews & Openers on Alibaba.com); custom logo, colour box and UPC barcodes are all available.
Orders are consolidated so multiple categories ship as a single entry.
